description: Source code implementing Qpack header table classes for QUIC protocol, including encoder and decoder header table management, header field lookup, insertion, eviction, and observer notification.

classes.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the encoder's dynamic header table, including insertion, header field lookup, and eviction logic.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the decoder's dynamic header table, including insertion, lookup, and observer notification.

methods.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable::InsertEntry
methods.description: Inserts a header field into the encoder's dynamic table, updating index mappings.

methods.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable::FindHeaderField
methods.description: Finds a header field in static or dynamic tables, returning match type and index.

methods.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable::MaxInsertSizeWithoutEvictingGivenEntry
methods.description: Calculates maximum size of new entries that can be inserted without evicting a specific entry.

methods.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable::draining_index
methods.description: Calculates the index up to which entries can be drained based on a fraction.

methods.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable::RemoveEntryFromEnd
methods.description: Removes the oldest entry from the end of the dynamic table.

methods.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable::InsertEntry
methods.description: Inserts a header field into the decoder's dynamic table and notifies observers if thresholds are met.

methods.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable::LookupEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a header entry by index, considering static or dynamic table.

methods.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable::RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to be notified when a certain insert count is reached.
